item.title: After Nearly Three Months, NYC Starbucks Workers Quietly End Strike
item.description: Starbucks workers at 10 unionized New York City stores quietly returned to work on Thursday, ending their nearly three-month strike after failing to force management back to the bargaining table for a first contract. item.title: Deaths Likely Due to Cold Rise to 22 Including Those Found At Private Residences
